parole.significato: nail polish; short for لاک ناخن (lâk-e nâxon, “nail polish”)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Prakrit 𑀮𑀓𑁆𑀔𑀸 (lakkhā, “lac”), from Sanskrit लाक्षा (lākṣā). Compare Hindi लाख (lākh, “lac”), English lac.
Borrowed from Hindustani (Hindi लूट (lūṭ) / Urdu لُوٹ (lūṭ)), from Prakrit लुट्ट (luṭṭa, “robbed”), from Sanskrit लुण्ट् (luṇṭ). See there for more.
